Guidance & outlook: STRENGTHENING LEADERSHIP TEAM FOR THE NEXT PHASE OF GROWTH CONTINUING LEADERSHIP Strategic Leadership Appointments FY26 Mr.Vikas Tanwar JOINT MANAGING DIRECTOR Appointed in FY26 to drive execution, systems and scaling of operations.
Customers today expect speed, visibility and reliability.

After providing for Current Tax, Deferred Tax adjustments and prior period tax provisions, the Company reported a Proﬁt After Tax (PAT) of , as against in FY 2024-25, registering a healthy growth of around 88%.
Growth & demand: Delhi Region Expanded presence in the North India logistics gateway Aurangabad (Maharashtra) New facility added Pan India warehouse network expansion across key logistics corridors 3PL OPERATIONS EXPANSION New 3PL warehousing operations launched for Jaquar at Nagpur and Aurangabad.
Revenue from operations reached Rs.257.66 crore while Proﬁt After Tax grew to Rs.15.06 crore.
Revenue from Operations increased substantially to as compared to in the previous year, registering a robust growth of approximately 200%.
Margins & costs: Dhanuka Agritech Ltd Agri inputs logistics partnership AGRI AND COMMODITIES Wagh Bakri FMCG and beverage logistics association.

Cost Records and Cost Audit As per the provisions of Section 148 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Cost Records and Audit) Rules, 2014, the requirement to maintain cost records and to appoint a Cost Auditor is applicable only to certain class of companies engaged in speciﬁed industries as notiﬁed by the Central Government.

Since the Company is engaged in the business of Logistics and Supply Chain Services, which does not fall under the prescribed class of industries, the provisions relating to maintenance of cost records and appointment of Cost Auditor are not applicable to the Company.
Capex & expansion: Rail Linked Warehousing Strategic rake handling expansion at multiple locations including Gandhidham, with throughput capacity scaling in line with BCN rake operations.
STRATEGIC ACQUISITION Successfully completed slump sale and acquisition of AKT Logistics LLP, adding scale, customer relationships and operational capabilities.

The Board believes that the strategic investments made during the year in warehousing infrastructure, ﬂeet expansion, multimodal logistics, technology-enabled operations and customer acquisition have established a strong foundation for sustainable long- term growth and enhanced stakeholder value.
Balance sheet & cash: In accordance with the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (“the Act”) as amended by and read with the provisions of the Finance Act, 2020, with effect from April 1, 2020, dividend paid or distrib- uted by the Company is taxable in the hands of shareholders and the Company is required to deduct tax at source (TDS) from dividend paid to the shareholders at…
As per relevant provisions, tax deducted shall be at the rate of 20% (plus applicable surcharge and cess) on the amount of dividend payable.

Transfer of Unclaimed Dividend to Investor Education Fund During the year under review, pursuant to the provisions of Section 124 and Section 125 [2] of the Companies Act,2013, no amount is required to be transferred to the Investor Education and Protection Fund, as of the company has not declared dividend any time in the earlier ﬁnancial years.
Risks & challenges: The delay was primarily attributable to unforeseen labour shortages and execution-related challenges encountered during February and March 2026.
Foreign Exchange Earnings and Outgo - Nil Nil Risk Management and Insurance Pursuant to Section 134(3)(n) of the Act, the Company has formulated and adopted the Risk Management Policy.

The Policy establishes the philosophy of the Company towards risk identiﬁcation, analysis and prioritization of risks, development of risk mitigation plans and reporting on the risk environment of the Company.
